data.name: Caleb
data.gender_notes: Caleb is used as a male name in christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Hebrew kelev, 'dog' — used as a name of loyalty and boldness. Its root is Hebrew k-l-b. Caleb, the faithful spy (Numbers 13-14). Caleb is a Hebrew name meaning “Dog; faithful; bold”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Caleb expresses “Dog; faithful; bold”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Hebrew kelev, 'dog' — used as a name of loyalty and boldness.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Caleb total 14, reducing to 5. Number 5 is associated with freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
